fields.climate: temperate; humid and overcast; mild, windy winters and cool summers
fields.terrain: low and flat to gently rolling plains
fields.hazards: flooding is a threat in some areas of the country (e.g., parts of Jutland, along the southern coast of the island of Lolland) that are protected from the sea by a system of dikes
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, fish, arable land, salt, limestone, chalk, stone, gravel and sand
fields.farm: milk, wheat, potatoes, barley, sugar beets, pork, rapeseed, rye, oats, chicken
fields.exports: packaged medicine, fish, vaccines, refined petroleum, pork
fields.industries: wind turbines, pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, shipbuilding and refurbishment, iron, steel, nonferrous metals, chemicals, food processing, machinery and transportation equipment, textiles and…
fields.languages: Danish, Faroese, Greenlandic (an Inuit dialect), German (small minority); note - English is the predominant second language
fields.religions: Evangelical Lutheran (official) 71.4%, Muslim 4.3%, other/none/unspecified (denominations include Roman Catholic, Jehovah's Witness, Serbian Orthodox Christian, Jewish, Baptist, Buddhist, Church of…

independence.event: unified and Christianized under Harald I GORMSSON

fields.legal: civil law; judicial review of legislative acts
fields.military: 18 years of age for compulsory and voluntary military service for men and women; draftees serve 11 months, including five months of basic training, followed by six months in an operational unit
